submission_results.hypothesis: The anonymous Answer created in recordDeepStubMock (the $2 class in the trace) captures the deep-stub mock and is not Serializable, so when the mock's stubbed-answer container is serialized it fails. Wrap it in a local Serializable Answer class so the stored answer can be serialized while still returning the captured mock.

Deep-stub mocks are created without serializable() settings, so the created mock is not serializable; enabling serializable mode on the settings used for deep-stub mocks should let the whole mock graph serialize.

edits.search: private Object recordDeepStubMock(final Object mock, InvocationContainerImpl container) throws Throwable {

submission_results.hypothesis: The anonymous Answer in recordDeepStubMock (ReturnsDeepStubs$2) is not Serializable. Introduce a Serializable abstract nested answer class and make the anonymous answer extend it. Also make deep-stub mock settings serializable so the captured mock can be serialized (the MockUtil NotSerializableException shows the mock itself must be serializable).
